verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents syncing Authenticator verification codes with Password Manager, which keeps tokens in the account rather than on one phone. It also documents vault export for backup and import to transfer data. However, the evidence never walks through restoring tokens on a replacement device after a phone is lost. missing for 10: explicit lost-device/new-device restore walkthrough for authenticator tokens, confirmation that synced codes repopulate a fresh install, independent hands-on corroboration of recovery.

support.subject: As an everyday user, losing my phone doesn't lose my accounts — a documented recovery path restores my tokens on a new device

citations.quote: Connect Authenticator with Password Manager to sync your verification codes. Once activated, the Bitwarden apps stay synchronized with any codes you add or edit
Export your vault data, including logins and notes, to back up important information or transfer to a new Bitwarden vault.
